inputs.bhat7: the seven primary targets of the development out-of-fold B-hat, exactly as B18; its fidelities must equal the recorded B18 values to 1e-12, else the analysis refuses
inputs.constant: the majority d_model decision on acdc_dev for every case
inputs.pca7: the first seven principal components of the 57 formal descriptors standardized on acdc_dev, fitted on acdc_dev; scores of each partition from the frozen PCA
inputs.permuted_bhat7: bhat7 with its acdc_dev rows permuted against d_model, 1,000 permutations (statistics.permutations); each fitted model evaluated on the unpermuted partitions
inputs.random7: standardized A times each of the 1,000 random 57 x 7 matrices (statistics.random_projections)

B23.metric: fidelity = agreement with d_model on every processed case of the partition, with Wilson intervals; for random7 and permuted_bhat7 the median and the 95th percentile (P95) of the 1,000 fidelities
B23.model: as B18: multinomial logistic regression with the audited-predictor settings of configs/formal.yaml (L2, C = 1.0, no search) on inputs standardized on acdc_dev

B23.target: the final audited predictor's decisions d_model on acdc_dev (formal/d_model_ACDC_dev.parquet)

B24.application: coverage and fidelity to the network's decisions on the three evaluated partitions with the frozen cuts and routing, as B16; accuracy among accepted cases on the same-definition subsets
B24.concepts: the network's probe reconstruction of the same seed: F9b (probes/f9b/seed20261011/) and F9b-M (postfreeze/B22/probes, seed 20261011); development out of fold for fitting, the frozen probe on the evaluated partitions
B24.consequent: the network's own decision (argmax of its class probabilities): on acdc_dev the out-of-fold decisions of the outer-fold networks (is_oof), on the evaluated partitions the final network
B24.decision_link: as B18, fitted on acdc_dev to the networks' out-of-fold decisions (the consequent; the final network's in-sample decisions are close to the labels) and evaluated against the final network's decisions, on the seven primary targets of the development out-of-fold probe reconstruction, with the PCA-7 and random-projection references of B23 computed on the final encoder's 64 activations standardized on acdc_dev; critical-QC cases excluded as in B18; descriptive, no reading

lr_decision_link_f9b7_and_activation_nul.target: out-of-fold network decisions (the consequent); evaluated against the final network

lr_decision_link_f9bm7_and_activation_nu.target: out-of-fold network decisions (the consequent); evaluated against the final network

rule_layer_f9_seed20261011.gate_substrate: nested_inner_oof of the probe (encoder f, inner folds of fold f)

rule_layer_f9m_seed20261011.gate_substrate: nested_inner_oof of the probe (encoder f, inner folds of fold f)

B24.note: F9-M decisions are below the majority-class rate on mms2_external (B22); its results there carry that note
B24.per_object_stability: not applied: the outer-fold probes map the outer-fold encoders' activations, which are recorded on acdc_dev only; no cell is UNSTABLE_ESTIMATE
B24.rule_layer: the full rule layer of Section 11 with the settings of configs/wedd.yaml and configs/rule_policy.yaml and the recorded folds: cuts, cut-stability eligibility, granules, variable-precision discovery and the cross-fitted gate fitted on acdc_dev with the network's decisions in place of d_model; frozen before evaluation

admission_sample.acdc_dev: the 98 development cases with the out-of-fold B-hat and the final d_model decisions (formal/d_model_ACDC_dev.parquet), as in the frozen rule layer, in their recorded outer folds
admission_sample.mms_external: the non-critical-QC mms_external cases with the frozen-bundle B-hat (reconstructed/bhat_mms_external.parquet) and the final d_model decision (never fitted on these cases); outer folds by statistics.b25_fold_assignment

B25.evaluation: admitted rules applied to mms2_external only, with the frozen cuts and the routing of Section 11.7: coverage (accepted / processed), fidelity to d_model among accepted and accuracy among accepted on the same-definition subset, with Wilson intervals; an empty rulebook is reported as such

fold_assignment.rule: all mms_external clusters of contracts/split_manifest.parquet, before any exclusion, sorted by SHA-256 of salt + cluster_id (UTF-8 hex digest), assigned to outer folds 1-5 round robin in that order; every case of a cluster in one fold

B25.frozen_objects: the recorded cuts, bins and concept eligibility of the d_model rulebook, the gate bounds of configs/rule_policy.yaml, the transition and the predictor; nothing is refitted
B25.gate: Section 11.6 exactly, with the pooled sample in place of acdc_dev: granules, discovery (at most three literals), support >= 5 patients, confidence >= 0.90, cross-fitted reproduction, pooled matches >= 5, Wilson lower bound >= 0.60; in each outer fold the acdc_dev rows take the substrate and decisions of the frozen Section 11.6 gate (recorded nested inner out-of-fold B-hat and the decisions of the predictor refitted without fold f, which must reproduce formal/d_model_crossfit_ACDC_dev.parquet on every held-out fold), the mms_external rows the frozen-bundle B-hat and the final d_model

gate_source.decisions: audited predictor refitted without fold f on the frozen gate rows (gate_rules); reproduces formal/d_model_crossfit_ACDC_dev.parquet on every held-out fold
gate_source.mms_external: frozen-bundle B-hat and final d_model in every fold
gate_source.substrate: recorded oof/inner_oof_ACDC_dev_fold1-5.parquet in outer-train(f), outer OOF B-hat held out

B25.symbols: frozen cuts applied to B-hat (mms_external before decoder domain blocking); a cell flagged UNSTABLE_ESTIMATE in the recorded stability table of mms_external satisfies no literal; the development out-of-fold B-hat has no recorded stability table and no unstable cell; class eligibility (at least five cases per class) is part of discovery on the pooled sample

B26.agreement: median bias and the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of d, each with a cluster-bootstrap interval, beside the recorded Bland-Altman bias and limits
B26.description: outliers against the other cases by vendor and center (M&Ms partitions), slice count, voxel volume and imaged volume (staging manifests); categorical cells with fewer than five cases merged into 'other', and the attribute suppressed for that group if 'other' still has fewer than five; a category with one to four cases in either group is merged into 'other' in both groups, and an attribute suppressed for either group is suppressed for both; vendor only for mms2_external (no center recorded); continuous attributes as median and interquartile range per group of at least five cases
B26.differences: d = B-hat - B in physical units per primary target, frozen bundle, OBSERVED cells
B26.geometry_check: for each outlier, whether it is still an outlier under the geometry-aware transition of B12 (same rule on its differences), with the frozen B12 model (postfreeze/B12/models/, hash-checked through the B12 provenance) applied to the 57 descriptors and the three log covariates; counts; no list of outliers is written
B26.outliers: statistics.b26_outlier_rule; counts per target and partition
B26.reference: inter-observer variability is not computed here; published values enter the manuscript only after verification at the source

large_error.development: the B17 threshold: per target, the acdc_dev out-of-fold 90th percentile of |B-hat - B| / s_j (postfreeze/B17 of v6-postfreeze-20261028-0201), read from its summary and recomputed; a difference above 1e-12 refuses
large_error.within_partition: per target, the top decile of |B-hat - B| / s_j within each evaluated partition (an outcome definition, not a setting of any method)

B27.metrics: AUROC of the signal for each large-error indicator (per target and any-large) with cluster-bootstrap intervals; Spearman correlation of the signal with |B-hat - B| / s_j per target
B27.reread: the B17 continuous signals (uncertainty, OOD score, count of unstable bins) under the within-partition definition
B27.signal: per evaluated case and primary target, the standard deviation (ddof = 1) of the reconstructions of the five recorded outer-fold transitions (transitions/fold_models/transition_fold1-5.json) decoded to the physical scale by each fold transition with its domain guard, divided by s_j; a cell has a signal only when all five fold values exist; case-level signal the maximum over the targets that have one
